message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or a holiday that creates a three‑day stretch when combined with a weekend). For each holiday I’ve noted the day of the week it fell on and the total days off (including the weekend).

| Date | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Length |
|------|---------|-------------|---------------------|
| **January 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | 3 days (Sat‑Sun) |
| **January 2** | New Year’s Day (observed) | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **February 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **March 17** | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Wednesday | 1 day (no long weekend) |
| **April 7** | Good Friday | Friday | 3 days (Fri‑Sat) |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **June 19** | Canada Day | Saturday | 3 days (Sat‑Sun) |
| **July 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | 3 days (Sat‑Sun) |
| **August 7** | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **September 18** | Labour Day | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **October 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **November 10** | Remembrance Day (observed) | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **December 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | 3 days (Mon‑Tue) |
| **December 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | 1 day (no long weekend) |

### Notes

1. **New Year’s Day** – Since 2023’s New Year’s Day fell on a Sunday, the statutory holiday was observed on Monday, January 2.  
2. **Family Day** – Observed only in Alberta, Saskatchewan, and Ontario.  
3. **St. Patrick’s Day** – A statutory holiday only in Ontario; it did not create a long weekend.  
4. **Good Friday** – Always a statutory holiday; it created a long weekend because it fell on a Friday.  
5. **Victoria Day** – Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25.  
6. **Canada Day** – Celebrated on July 1; the holiday fell on a Saturday, giving a three‑day weekend.  
7. **Civic Holiday** – Observed on the first Monday in August in most provinces (not in Quebec, Newfoundland & Labrador, or Prince Edward Island).  
8. **Labour Day** – First Monday in September.  
9. **Thanksgiving** – Second Monday in October.  
10. **Remembrance Day** – Observed on the nearest weekday if it falls on a weekend; in 2023 it fell on a Saturday, so it was observed on Monday, November 10.  
11. **Christmas & Boxing Day** – Christmas fell on a Monday, giving a long weekend; Boxing Day fell on a Tuesday, so it did not create a long weekend.

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app. If you need the same information for other years or additional details (e.g., province‑specific holidays), let me know!
